title: a member reports something, and the operator can take a photo down

criteria.text: A signed-in member sends a free-text report from an item or shop page
criteria.note: `ReportControl` on the Page and post cards; `sendReportAction` refuses signed-out callers (#81, #82) [V] Checked: `[guards F058.1]` in `f058-criteria.test.tsx` [V] Reviewed: #81, #82 carry no `Reviewed by:` [V] Shipped: no deploy-health run on their merge commits (14 Sep) [V] Smoked: `page` and `page-business` opened green 2026-10-16 as member and stranger; the route loads, no report is sent [A]

criteria.text: A report changes nothing visible to anyone, including the reported party
criteria.note: RETIRED. Overtaken by F078 criteria 2 and 3 and the 2026-10-11 courtesy-notice ruling in F078 `## Rulings`: a second report hides the item and the owner is told why (`create.test.ts`: "F078 criterion 3 amends F058 acceptance 2"). What still holds: the reporter is never named to the owner (`tests/report-privacy-db.test.ts`) [V]. `sync-roadmap` amends the scenario.

criteria.text: Only the operator sees or can invoke Remove; others rejected by the handler
criteria.note: `report.remove` and `report.reverse` refuse a member, an owner and an unset operator before the database; `/admin/reports` is 404 to others [V] Checked: `[guards F058.3]` in `f058-criteria.test.tsx` [V] Reviewed: #151 no `Reviewed by:` [V] Shipped: #151 has no deploy-health run [V] Smoked: `admin-reports` green as operator 2026-10-14 (no admin change since) [V]

criteria.text: Removal stops every surface serving the photo, writes who/when/why, listing survives
criteria.note: `report.remove` sets `photo_removed_at`, keeps the URL, writes `report_decisions`; Page, share cards and Browse read it, and the map now does too (#779, a265d7c) [V] Checked: only a partial marker (`useMapPages.test.ts:82`); `review.test.ts` is unmarked; #833 [V] Reviewed: #151, #152 no `Reviewed by:`; #779 none [V] Shipped: #151, #152 no deploy-health run; #779 green [V] Smoked: `explore` and `page` green 2026-10-16 [A]

criteria.text: The report reaches a place a person reads
criteria.note: Every report lands in the `/admin/reports` queue; urgent categories also alert the operator, by email through Resend until Twilio exists (#751), by SMS once the Twilio values are set [V] Checked: `[guards F058.5]` in `f058-criteria.test.tsx` [V] Reviewed: #151 no `Reviewed by:` [V] Shipped: #151 no deploy-health run [V] Smoked: `admin-reports` green 2026-10-14 [V]

criteria.text: Every decision reversible from the item by a new decision; reviewer sees history
criteria.note: `report_decisions` append-only, `reverses_decision_id`, history on the card, one reversal per decision [V] Checked: `[guards F058.6]` in `f058-criteria.test.tsx` [V] Reviewed: #152 no `Reviewed by:` [V] Shipped: #152 no deploy-health run [V] Smoked: `admin-reports` green 2026-10-14 [V]
